 1. DATABASE MIGRATIONS (applied via Supabase MCP)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  [A] 20260317_add_event_registration_ml
      - Kolom baru di soraku.events: registrationurl, discordchannelid
      - Tabel baru soraku.eventregistrations:
          id, eventid, teamname, teamlogourl,
          activeplayers (jsonb), reserveplayers (jsonb),
          contactname, contactdiscord, status, notes,
          createdat, updatedat
      - RLS: INSERT public, SELECT published only, ALL service_role
      - Trigger: set_updated_at

  [B] 20260317_fix_eventregistrations_permissions_and_gametype
      - FIX: GRANT ALL ON eventregistrations TO service_role/authenticated/anon
        Root cause: RLS policy saja tidak cukup tanpa GRANT eksplisit
        service_role.can_insert sebelumnya = false → sekarang = true ✅
      - Kolom baru di soraku.events: gametype TEXT
        CHECK IN ('ml','valorant','freefire','pubg','chess','other')

  [C] 20260317_events_registration_v2_paid_status
      - Kolom baru di soraku.events: ispaid BOOLEAN, price INTEGER, priceinfo TEXT
      - Kolom baru di soraku.eventregistrations:
          userid (FK auth.users), paymentstatus, paymentproof,
          reviewedby, reviewedat, rejectreason

  [D] 20260318_events_add_registration_open_flag
      - Kolom baru di soraku.events: registrationopen BOOLEAN DEFAULT false


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 2. API ROUTES (apps/web/src/app/api/)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  GET  /api/events/[slug]
       - Public: ambil detail event (id, title, coverurl, gametype,
         ispaid, price, priceinfo, registrationopen, dll)

  POST /api/events/[slug]/register
       - Daftar tim (public)
       - Validasi: teamname, activeplayers (min 1), reserveplayers (max 5)
       - Insert ke eventregistrations + hitung total pendaftar
       - Kirim Discord embed ke DISCORD_REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_URL via
         lib/discord-webhook.ts (baca dari DB sitesettings, fallback ENV)

  GET  /api/events/[slug]/register
       - Admin only: list semua pendaftaran event

  PATCH /api/events/[slug]/register/[regId]
       - Admin only: terima (approved) atau tolak (rejected)
       - Simpan reviewedby, reviewedat, rejectreason
       - Kirim Discord embed notif status ke DISCORD_REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_URL

  GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/events/[id]
       - PATCH schema ditambah: registrationopen, ispaid, price, priceinfo

  POST /api/admin/events
       - Schema ditambah: registrationurl, gametype, ispaid, price, priceinfo
       - Saat publish: kirim Discord embed ke DISCORD_EVENT_WEBHOOK_URL


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 3. UTILITY (apps/web/src/lib/)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  lib/discord-webhook.ts  (BARU)
       - getWebhookUrl(key): baca dari DB sitesettings → fallback ENV
         In-memory cache 60 detik, skip placeholder 'PASTE_DISCORD...'
       - sendDiscordWebhook(key, payload): fetch + error logging ke console
         Tidak silent lagi, error terlog di Vercel runtime logs

  lib/discord-webhook.ts target keys:
       'discord_event_webhook_url'        → announce event baru
       'discord_registration_webhook_url' → notif pendaftaran & review

       - Input URL gambar dengan paste, drag & drop, upload clipboard
       - Mode: full (preview besar) dan compact (preview inline)
       - Validasi URL dengan load test image
       - Indikator: loading / OK / error
       - Tombol clipboard paste manual dan tombol X hapus

 5. HALAMAN PUBLIK (apps/web/src/app/(public)/events/)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  /events  (page.tsx — REDESIGN)
       - Grid: 1 kolom mobile → 2 sm → 3 lg
       - Layout card:
           Kiri atas  : badge 🎟️ Gratis / 💰 Rp X.XXX
           Kanan atas : badge Upcoming/Selesai + Online/Offline
           Bawah desc : tags (maks 3)
           Kanan bawah: countdown "X hari lagi" jika ≤ 7 hari
       - Data fetch: tambah gametype, registrationopen

  /events/[slug]  (page.tsx — UPDATE)
       - Cover image: <Image fill unoptimized> + fallback gradient
       - Badge Free/Paid + info rekening setelah deskripsi
       - CTA section berdasarkan registrationopen:
           BUKA (🟢) → tombol "Daftar Tim ML" atau link eksternal
           TUTUP (🔴) → tombol "Pantau di Discord"
                         link: https://discord.gg/CJJ7KEJMbg

  /events/[slug]/daftar  (page.tsx — BARU + UPDATE)
       GUARD: hanya user yang sudah login bisa akses
       - Cek /api/auth/me → kalau belum login: screen redirect ke /login
       - Guard gametype: kalau bukan ML → redirect balik ke event page
       
       Form 3 Langkah:
       Step 1 — Info Tim
           • Nama Tim (wajib)
           • Logo Tim (ImageUrlInput compact, opsional)
           • Nama & Discord PIC (opsional)
           • Catatan tambahan
       Step 2 — Pemain
           • Pemain Aktif: 1–10 orang, field Nama/Nickname/Role ML
           • Pemain Cadangan: 0–5 orang (opsional)
           • Role options: Goldlaner/Jungler/Midlaner/Roamer/EXP Laner/Hyper
       Step 3 — Konfirmasi + Bukti Bayar
           • Preview ringkasan tim & pemain
           • Jika event ispaid:
               - Upload file gambar langsung (auto-upload freeimage.host)
               - Preview gambar setelah upload
               - Fallback: paste URL manual
               - WAJIB diisi sebelum submit
           • Submit → POST /api/events/[slug]/register

       Sukses: tampil screen konfirmasi + ID pendaftaran

 6. HALAMAN ADMIN (apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/admin/events/)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  /admin/events  (page.tsx — REDESIGN)
       Tab Navbar "Event | Pendaftaran" di sebelah judul (seperti profile page)

       TAB EVENT:
       - Tabel: Nama, Tanggal, Tipe, Status Publish, Status Daftar, Aksi
       - Badge 🎟️ Gratis / 💰 Bayar per event
       - Kolom "Daftar": toggle 🔓 Buka / 🔒 Tutup pendaftaran per baris
         → PATCH /api/admin/events/[id] { registrationopen }
       - Ikon 👥 → pindah ke tab Pendaftaran + load regs event itu

       TAB PENDAFTARAN:
       - Pills pilih event ML
       - Stats: Total / Menunggu / Diterima / Ditolak
       - Tombol Buka/Tutup pendaftaran di header
       - List pendaftar:
           • Nomor urut, logo tim, nama tim, kontak PIC
           • Badge status: Menunggu (kuning) / Diterima (hijau) / Ditolak (merah)
           • Tombol ✓ Terima + ✕ Tolak (hanya muncul status Menunggu)
           • Panel bukti bayar dengan tombol "Lihat ↗"
           • Panel alasan tolak (jika rejected)
       - Reject Modal: textarea alasan + konfirmasi

  /admin/events/new  (page.tsx — UPDATE)
       - Selector game type: ML/Valorant/FreeFire/PUBG/Catur/Lainnya
         Badge info "Form Pendaftaran ML Aktif" jika pilih ML
       - Cover input: ImageUrlInput full mode (preview h-28)
       - Link Pendaftaran Eksternal (opsional, override form ML)
       - Toggle Free / Berbayar:
           Berbayar → field Harga (Rp) + textarea Info Rekening

 7. BUG FIXES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  [FIX-1] permission denied for table eventregistrations
          Root cause: RLS policy 'true' tidak cukup tanpa GRANT eksplisit
          Fix: GRANT ALL ON eventregistrations TO service_role/authenticated/anon

  [FIX-2] Cover events tidak tampil di public
          Root cause: <Image> belum dipakai (masih div placeholder)
                      + next.config.ts tidak allow wildcard CDN domain
          Fix: Ganti div placeholder → <Image fill unoptimized>
               Tambah { hostname: "**" } wildcard di remotePatterns

  [FIX-3] Discord webhook tidak terkirim (silent fail)
          Root cause: DISCORD_*_WEBHOOK_URL tidak di-set di Vercel ENV
                      + kode pakai fire-and-forget catch(() => {})
          Fix: lib/discord-webhook.ts baca URL dari DB sitesettings dulu
               + await + console.error logging

  [FIX-4] DiscordAPIError[50013] Missing Permissions di Railway logs
          Root cause: guildMemberAdd.js fetch invites tanpa cek ManageGuild
          Fix: tambah guard sebelum fetch:
               if (!me?.permissions.has('ManageGuild')) return;

  [FIX-5] Paste URL cover/logo tidak bisa (input type="url" block paste)
          Root cause: browser mobile validasi URL native di type="url"
          Fix: Ganti ke type="text" dalam komponen ImageUrlInput

 9. PENDING — PERLU DIKERJAKAN OLEH TIM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  [SORA — URGENT]
  Set webhook URL di Supabase SQL Editor (tidak perlu redeploy):

    UPDATE soraku.sitesettings
    SET value = '"https://discord.com/api/webhooks/WEBHOOK_ID/TOKEN"'
    WHERE key = 'discord_registration_webhook_url';

    UPDATE soraku.sitesettings
    SET value = '"https://discord.com/api/webhooks/WEBHOOK_ID/TOKEN"'
    WHERE key = 'discord_event_webhook_url';

  Cara buat webhook Discord:
    Server → Channel target → Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks → New → Copy URL

  Channel tujuan:
    discord_registration_webhook_url → channel ID 1483340741194289172
    discord_event_webhook_url        → channel announce event server 1116971049045729302

  [SORA — AUTH]
  Set Supabase Auth URL config:
    Site URL      : https://soraku.vercel.app
    Redirect URLs : https://soraku.vercel.app/**

  [KAIZO — OPTIONAL]
  Admin edit page /admin/events/[id]/edit belum punya field:
    - gametype, ispaid, price, priceinfo, registrationopen, registrationurl
  Perlu diupdate agar admin bisa edit event yang sudah dibuat.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 10. ALUR SISTEM LENGKAP (Events ML)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  ADMIN BUAT EVENT:
  /admin/events/new
    → pilih game type ML
    → isi judul, deskripsi, tanggal, cover, free/paid + harga
    → klik Publish
    → Discord embed terkirim ke channel announce (DISCORD_EVENT_WEBHOOK_URL)
    → event tampil di /events publik

  ADMIN BUKA PENDAFTARAN:
  /admin/events → kolom "Daftar" → klik 🔓 Buka
    → registrationopen = true
    → tombol "Daftar Tim ML" muncul di /events/[slug]

  USER DAFTAR:
  /events/[slug] → klik "Daftar Tim ML"
    → guard: cek login → kalau belum: redirect /login?next=...
    → /events/[slug]/daftar
    → Step 1: isi nama tim, logo, kontak
    → Step 2: isi pemain aktif + cadangan
    → Step 3: review + upload bukti bayar (wajib jika paid)
    → submit → data masuk ke eventregistrations
    → Discord embed terkirim ke channel pendaftaran (DISCORD_REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_URL)

  ADMIN REVIEW:
  /admin/events → tab Pendaftaran → pilih event
    → lihat daftar tim + bukti bayar
    → klik ✓ Terima atau ✕ Tolak (+ isi alasan)
    → status update di DB
    → Discord embed notif diterima/ditolak terkirim

  ADMIN TUTUP PENDAFTARAN:
  /admin/events → kolom "Daftar" → klik 🔒 Tutup
    → registrationopen = false
    → tombol daftar hilang, muncul "Pantau di Discord"
    → link: https://discord.gg/CJJ7KEJMbg
